themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, or interact with systems for research purposes.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, including security aspects and agentic behavior.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing various AI-powered tools specifically for research operations, synthesis, and analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles on AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic real users for testing or analysis.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Content related to AI's application in the design process, from generation to evaluation and system integration.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Articles on how AI tools and techniques can assist product managers in their workflow, strategy, and decision-making.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the analysis of user opinions, reviews, and feedback using AI to gauge sentiment and inform product development.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to automate or enhance usability testing processes and gather insights.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in analyzing and deriving insights from qualitative data, such as interviews and open-ended responses.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
